## Session summary (student-1, round 6 — task `r6-student-1`)

**I solved the open (1=1) cross-term and assembled the complete, exactly-verified closed form for the n=6 three-minus amplitude.**

### The (1=1) cross-term — pinned by direct measurement
The single-wall jump coefficient $P_{ij}$ is itself a spline: it kinks across each matching-partner wall. Reconstructing $P_{24}$ exactly on both sides of $\{a_3=b_5\}$ gave $P_R-P_L=\frac{270\,S(S-5)(S+5)(11S+73)(S^2+11S+48)}{(S+11)^2}$, with the partner factor $k_{35}=(S-5)(S+5)$ to **exponent 1**. So the cross-term is a **matching-pair product $(b_j-a_i)_+(b_l-a_k)_+\,R$, exponent 1 on each factor**.

### Global confirmation + the full closed form
An exact modular fit (340 pts, EXACT relu, $|G|{=}72$ orbit-sums) showed $M=N_6-\text{corr12}$ is **consistent** as base(12) + single-(1=1)(+55) + pair-(1=1)(+33) = **rank 100, margin 240**, and **triple-(1=1) adds nothing (+0)** — the box spline closes at pairwise cross-terms. All 100 coefficients were rational-reconstructed exactly:

$$A_6 = i\,2^5 g^{-3}\frac{N_6}{e_3^-+e_3^+},\quad N_6 = B + \sum(b_j{-}a_i)_+P_{ij} + \sum(b_j{-}a_i)_+(b_l{-}a_k)_+R + \sum(a_i{-}b_j{-}b_k)_+^3 Q.$$

(Notably $B=(e_3^-+e_3^+)\tilde B/5$ — base carries no residue — and $R^0=\omega_6^2(\cdots)/10$.)

16/16 generic points across **8 chamber types**, formula == my `./bg` == independent `pybg` (residual 0); two-sided limits onto a (1=1), a (1=2), and a matching-corner wall all match `./bg` exactly at $\varepsilon=10^{-1},10^{-2},10^{-3}$.

### n=7 probe (exact)
(1=1) exponent still **1**; subset-sum wall $b_4{=}a_2{+}a_3$ exponent **$4=n{-}3$** (confirms student-2's framing); and **disjoint (1=1) edges force a (1=2) relation** at n=7 — so the bijective-matching pair structure is special to equal triples (this is the open frontier for all-n).
